enchantments.tooltip: Enhanced Ki +1: Increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack.
Deadly +3: +3 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Crippling: A crippling weapon is infused with binding power so that when a target is critically hit their movement is slowed by half.Note: Real slowdown is only 25%
Combat Mastery +3: +3 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
